name: semantic-hedge-fund
description: Turn an investment thesis into structured prediction-market hedge research.

interface.shortDescription: Find prediction-market hedges for portfolio bad states.
interface.longDescription: Describe an asset, portfolio, or investment thesis. Semantic Hedge Fund separates wanted and unwanted exposures, researches Polymarket and Kalshi candidates, evaluates causal fit, settlement rules, timing, liquidity, cost, and basis risk, then produces a table-first report with concrete holdings. Research only; it never executes trades.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze my investment thesis and find prediction-market hedges that could pay in the states where it loses money.
